$comment: Variants of the corpus papers, each changing ONE thing about where the body ends. Built and counted by test/e2e/tex/page-count.e2e.ts; each edit's `find` must occur exactly once. The expected end was established by rendering the built PDF, not by the detector.

variants.name: barovox-references-at-top
variants.change: a \clearpage before the bibliography: the references start at the top of a page
variants.evidence: Page 13 ends with the acknowledgment and blank space; page 14 opens with «References» at the top of the left column.

variants.name: barovox-subsection-references
variants.change: an unnumbered \subsection*{References} in the body, and a sentence opening with the word
variants.evidence: The inserted «References» subsection heading is on page 2; page 13 is as in the paper: conclusion and acknowledgment, then «References» mid-column.

variants.name: barovox-table-references-header
variants.change: a table in the body whose column header reads «References»
variants.evidence: The inserted one-column table with the header «References» is on page 2; page 13 is as in the paper.

variants.name: barovox-appendix-before-references
variants.change: the appendix moved before the bibliography
variants.evidence: Page 13: the conclusion and the acknowledgment, then «Appendix A. Basics of Cleanrooms» in the left column; the bibliography now starts on page 15, after Appendix F.

variants.name: leaking-no-hyperref
variants.change: hyperref replaced by url: no bibliography anchors, so the text heading decides
variants.evidence: Page 13 as in the paper: Table 6, body in both columns, «References» in the right column. No hyperref: the PDF has no bibliography anchors.

variants.name: leaking-no-hyperref-subsection-references
variants.change: hyperref replaced by url, and an unnumbered \subsection*{References} in the body: the heading followed by [1] must win
variants.evidence: The inserted «References» subsection heading is on page 2; page 13 as in the paper. No hyperref: the heading followed by [1] must be told from the inserted one.

variants.name: rr-appendix-after-references
variants.change: the appendix moved after the bibliography
variants.evidence: Page 11: «7. Conclusion» in the right column, then «References» below it; the appendix follows the bibliography.
